messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

Below is a quick‑reference list of the **national public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, you’ll want to add the province‑specific holidays such as Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, etc.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | **Dec 31 – Jan 2** | Observed on Jan 2 (Monday) |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **May 20 – May 22** | |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Observed on Jul 3 (Monday) |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Saturday | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Observed on Nov 13 (Monday) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | — | Not a long weekend |

### Province‑specific note
- **Family Day** (third Monday in February) is observed in several provinces (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.).  
  - **Feb 20, 2023** (Monday) → long weekend **Feb 18 – Feb 20** in those provinces.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the full list of provincial holidays or want to adjust for observed dates that fall on weekends, let me know!
